landing.hero.headline_1: What do you want to shoot?
landing.hero.subheadline: Uptown turns a photo or a simple idea into a video. Start with a ready-made effect, or shape a new scene in chat.
video.clone.prompts.monster_bakery_text: The enormous cake suddenly rises another foot and releases a soft burst of flour. The little orange monster stumbles backward, catches the wooden spoon, blinks twice in comic disbelief, then breaks into a delighted grin. Flour curls through the warm oven light and copper pans wobble gently. Preserve the original monster design, exactly two teal horns, bakery layout and theatrical family-animation style. Smooth expressive character motion, playful timing, no new characters, no text, no logos.
video.clone.prompts.web_acrobat_text: Epic IMAX-style aerial chase at bright golden hour. An entirely original crimson-masked web acrobat launches from the glass crown of a skyscraper, fires a silver cable-web and swings in one powerful arc through a sunlit canyon of towers above busy traffic. The camera dives behind the hero, passes close to reflective windows, then pulls wide to reveal the glowing city skyline. Athletic motion, believable gravity, dramatic parallax, premium superhero feature-film cinematography, original suit design with no recognizable emblem, no text, no logos.
video.clone.prompts.paper_dragon_text: Bright cinematic stop-motion macro shot of a colorful pop-up book opening by itself on a sunlit children’s art-studio table. A tiny scarlet paper dragon unfolds from the center crease, stretches its accordion wings, then leaps into the air and circles once above the book as cheerful paper trees bend in its wake. Colorful paper scraps spiral through warm midday sunbeams. Handmade paper fibers, practical stop-motion imperfections, playful monster energy, clean pastel background, precise readable motion, no text, no logos, no human hands.
video.clone.prompts.glacier_titan_text: Epic IMAX-style wide shot at a brilliant alpine sunrise. A colossal ancient stone titan slowly rises from beneath a blue glacier as sheets of ice break away and a controlled avalanche rolls into the valley. Two tiny rescue helicopters sweep past the camera to reveal the immense scale while the titan turns toward the first sunlight. Photorealistic feature-film visual effects, majestic rather than frightening, crisp bright atmosphere, natural rock and snow physics, no text, no logos.
video.clone.prompts.airglide_text: GoPro footage of someone airgliding through the mountains, shaky camera footage.
video.clone.prompts.poppies_text: Millions of red poppy flowers slowly grow from a grassy desert landscape under clear skies.
video.clone.prompts.monster_commuter_tex: The subway car rocks gently as it moves. The giant sea-green monster carefully shifts its tiny briefcase to one claw, ducks under a hanging rail and gives a small sleepy yawn. Its long fur responds naturally to the train motion while nearby commuters glance up with restrained smiles. The camera makes a slow handheld push forward. Preserve the original friendly creature, passengers and photorealistic practical-effects look. No panic, no extra monster, no text, no logos.
video.clone.prompts.dragon_text: A dragon flying over New York City, cinematic drone shot.
video.clone.prompts.koi_train_text: The dancer completes one slow, precise turn in the train aisle while the three porcelain koi orbit her in a smooth counter-clockwise path. Rain continues sliding down the windows, the carriage sways almost imperceptibly, fabric and hair respond naturally, and the camera makes a subtle push forward. Preserve the original face, costume, carriage composition and cool blue lighting. No new people, no extra fish, no text.
video.clone.prompts.conservatory_text: The botanist takes two careful steps through the shallow water and raises one hand. The tiny bioluminescent seeds gather into a loose spiral above their palm, casting faint cyan reflections that move across the flooded floor. Ferns stir in a soft draft and the camera drifts slowly to the right. Preserve the greenhouse architecture, yellow raincoat, moonlit atmosphere and realistic scale. No text, no logos.
video.clone.prompts.rain_market_text: Macro cinematic shot looking into a rain puddle on a quiet city street. Inside the reflection, a tiny night market comes alive with miniature canvas stalls, steam, warm lanterns and people moving naturally. A raindrop lands and sends a slow ripple across the entire miniature world while the camera gently lowers toward the water. Photorealistic, tactile scale, believable reflections, no text, no logos.
video.clone.prompts.orb_text: A silver translucent orb floats through the streets of London, handheld camera footage.
video.clone.prompts.tidal_text: A cinematic wide shot of an old coastal library at night as a shallow tide slowly flows between the bookshelves. Loose pages lift gently in the sea breeze, small silver fish pass through reflected moonlight on the floor, and the camera makes one calm forward dolly. Photorealistic practical set, restrained motion, natural water physics, subtle 35mm film grain, no text, no logos.
video.clone.prompts.laundromat_text: A cinematic midnight laundromat in winter. Long white sheets slowly rise from open washing machines and billow through the room like sails in a quiet ocean wind. A lone attendant stands still at the back while fluorescent ceiling light mixes with deep blue street light. The camera moves laterally at a steady human pace, revealing realistic cloth physics, subtle reflections on the tile floor and drifting steam. Photorealistic practical set, restrained surrealism, no readable text, no logos.
video.clone.prompts.ship_text: A ship sailing through rough waters, grey skies, cinematic ocean spray.
video.clone.prompts.asteroids_text: A field of glowing asteroids drifts past the camera in deep space, with cinematic light and enormous scale.
video.clone.prompts.woman_text: A cinematic close-up of a woman turning toward soft window light, with natural movement and subtle facial expression.

landing.faq.title: Everything you need to know about Uptown
landing.faq.q_1: What is Uptown and how does it work?
landing.faq.a_1: Uptown creates video from text or a still image. Use a ready-made effect for a guided photo-to-video flow, or describe a new scene in chat.
landing.faq.q_2: How long does a render take?
landing.faq.a_2: Usually a few minutes. Video models queue and render far slower than image models — a 5-second clip is typically 1–3 minutes, a 10-second one longer. You can keep chatting while it works.
landing.faq.q_3: How long can a clip be?
landing.faq.a_3: Standard, Fast and Pro support 4–15 seconds per render. Ultra supports 4–30 seconds. Generate shots one at a time for a longer sequence.
landing.faq.a_4: Choose Seedance 2.0 Mini, Fast, Seedance 2.0 or Seedance 2.5. All of them support generated audio.
landing.faq.q_5: Can I turn my own photo into a video?
landing.faq.a_5: Yes. Upload a still and describe what should move. The image becomes the opening frame and the model animates from there — a product turntable, a portrait that blinks, a landscape with drifting clouds.
landing.faq.q_6: Can I use the generated videos commercially?
landing.faq.a_6: Yes. All paid plans include a full commercial license. Check the terms of the specific model you used if you plan to publish at scale.
landing.faq.q_7: How does the credit pricing work?
landing.faq.a_7: A standard 12-second 720p video costs 10 credits. Other models, resolutions and lengths use the pricing table, with the total rounded up to a whole credit. The composer shows the total before you send. Failed renders return your credits. One-time pack credits never expire; subscription credits expire at the end of their billing period. Yearly plans grant the whole year’s allowance up front.
landing.faq.q_8: How does Uptown protect my privacy?
landing.faq.a_8: Your uploads and clips are encrypted in transit and at rest. We never train on your content. You can permanently delete any conversation or clip at any time.
landing.faq.a_9: Yes — an account is what holds your clips, your take history and your credit balance. Sign-up takes about ten seconds via email or Google.
landing.faq.q_10: How can I provide feedback or report issues?
landing.faq.a_10: Open a ticket from the dashboard, or email us — we read every message and ship fixes weekly.

create.bulin_prompt_1: Place the person in the uploaded portrait as the lead in an energetic Dominican street freestyle circle after dark. A friend holds a compact speaker beside them while a close crowd watches. The performer gives a relaxed, rhythmic shoulder bounce, leans toward the speaker, and gestures on the beat. Medium handheld framing with a gentle natural camera sway; keep the whole face clear and the lead centered. Red doorway light, warm skin tones, candid phone-video texture, lively but believable movement.
create.bulin_prompt_2: Turn the person in the uploaded portrait into the lead of a lively sidewalk freestyle cypher. Keep a speaker-holder nearby and a loose semicircle of onlookers behind them. The performer steps forward once, nods to the rhythm, and turns slightly toward the crowd. Start in a medium-wide handheld shot and make a subtle push closer while keeping the lead in frame. Red-tinted night lighting, spontaneous street energy, natural motion and a candid social-video look.
create.bulin_prompt_3: Feature the person in the uploaded portrait at the center of a crowded street freestyle moment. They rap with confident but natural hand gestures and a small shoulder bounce while friends react behind them. Use a steady medium shot with a light handheld drift; keep the lead face unobstructed and the crowd secondary. Deep red light near the doorway, warm highlights, gritty night atmosphere, realistic phone-camera footage and one continuous take.
create.bridges_prompt_1: Place the person in the uploaded portrait as the lead at a lively private dinner party inspired by the Burning Bridges AI trend. The room has dark wood panelling, crystal chandeliers, and well-dressed guests in the background. The lead steps into the light holding a small silver cup and gives the camera a confident look. Use a medium-wide, gently drifting handheld shot that keeps the full face in frame. Warm amber practical lights, glossy highlights, intimate late-night mood, realistic motion and a polished social-video feel.
create.bridges_prompt_2: Make the person in the uploaded portrait the center of a chandelier-lit private party. Guests mingle softly in the background while the lead raises a silver cup in a small toast, lowers it, and gives a relaxed wave to the camera. Frame as a medium shot with a slow, subtle push-in and steady natural movement. Warm gold light against dark wood, reflective glass, celebratory but understated atmosphere, clear face and consistent outfit.
create.bridges_prompt_3: Show the person in the uploaded portrait at a crowded, elegant dinner party under crystal chandeliers. The lead glances across the room, briefly shades their eyes while searching the crowd, then turns back and waves at the camera. Keep the action simple and readable in one continuous medium-wide shot with gentle handheld drift. Amber chandelier light, rich wood details, soft background guests, cinematic contrast and natural human movement.

home.definition_title: Five in a row, lead in the middle
home.definition: The trend rebuilds the street-dance setup from the 2014 Mark Ronson ft. Bruno Mars video: five dancers in a row, the lead in the middle, a city street, suit-and-crew energy. Uptown Funk AI does that with a photo of you. The walk, the turn to camera, and the dance are generated. Your clothes stay the ones in the photo. A soundtrack under the clip is a trend bed, not the official 2014 recording.
home.about: Gary Lau (@garylau_ai) posted the version that spread, on X and Bilibili, on 7 October 2026. It runs about 143 seconds. The joke is the “guys who made RAM expensive,” dancing happily: Elon Musk leads, and the line often includes Jensen Huang, Sam Altman, Mark Zuckerberg, and Sundar Pichai. The Bilibili original passed 1.5 million plays. More than 80 remakes showed up on Bilibili that October, including a Zhao Benshan cast, emperors, an Avengers lineup, and esports teams, plus copies on TikTok, Reels, Shorts, and Instagram. That is separate from AI voice covers and from the older non-AI TikTok dance challenge. Uptown did not start the meme. The form on this page makes your own lead.

home.faq_description: What it is, who posted the CEO clip, and how a photo becomes a video.
home.faq_a1: An AI video generator for the street-crew dance. One clear photo becomes a short widescreen clip, about 12 seconds in 16:9, with you leading five dancers. Uptown is not affiliated with Mark Ronson, Bruno Mars, or their labels.
home.faq_q2: Who started the Uptown Funk AI trend?
home.faq_a2: Gary Lau (@garylau_ai) posted a tech-CEO cast on X and Bilibili on 7 October 2026. The clip is about 143 seconds. The joke is the people who made RAM expensive, dancing happily, with Elon Musk in the lead and a line that often includes Jensen Huang, Sam Altman, Mark Zuckerberg, and Sundar Pichai. The Bilibili original passed 1.5 million plays, and more than 80 remakes appeared on Bilibili in October 2026. Uptown did not make that clip.
home.faq_q3: Is the Uptown Funk AI video real or generated?
home.faq_a3: Generated. The face comes from the photo you upload. The street, the other dancers, and the motion are AI. It is not footage of that person on the street, and it is not the original music video. AI voice covers of the song, and the older non-AI TikTok dance challenge, are different.
home.faq_q4: How do I make an Uptown Funk video from a photo?
home.faq_a4: Sign in, upload one clear photo, check the credit cost, and generate. You do not write a prompt or edit in CapCut. The one-photo result is about 12 seconds at 16:9: walk, sing to the camera, then dance. JPG, PNG, or WebP, up to 10 MB. Use a photo you have permission to use.
home.faq_q5: Does the clip include the Uptown Funk song?
home.faq_a5: Not the official master. A soundtrack can sit under the dance, but it is not the 2014 Mark Ronson and Bruno Mars recording, and this site does not sell or license that track. The product makes the street-crew video, not an AI cover of the vocal.
home.faq_q6: What is the CEO Uptown Funk AI video?
home.faq_a6: A fan-made AI version, not an official ad. The version that spread puts tech CEOs in the five-person street line, Musk in the middle, on the joke about RAM prices. Later posts swapped in other casts. With one photo you can put yourself, or someone who agreed, in that lead spot.
